channelTitle: A spoonful of this dark syrup was grandma's answer to feeling run down
hook: Dragging through the day with no energy? Before supplements lined the shelves, this thick, dark syrup was a spoonful families swore by.
remedy: As a time-honored piece of home wisdom, taking a spoonful of blackstrap molasses, often stirred into warm water or milk, has long been used as an old-fashioned pick-me-up when energy runs low.
steps: Stir a tablespoon of blackstrap molasses into a cup of warm water or milk
Drink it in the morning or whenever you're feeling low on energy
Sip slowly rather than gulping it down
caution: Molasses is high in sugar, so those managing diabetes should check with a doctor first. It can also have a mild laxative effect in large amounts.
cta: Does a spoonful of molasses sound like something your grandmother did, or did she have a different pick-me-up? Tell Grandma June below.
